title: Yellow Browned Saudi Arabian Beef Kidney Kebabs
description: A jammy, cheese-pull, date-night Saudi Arabian dish featuring beef kidney, deep-fried to perfection, ovo-vegetarian friendly
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced beef kidney to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Dip each coated beef kidney piece into the beaten eggs, making sure they are fully coated.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep fry the egg-coated beef kidney pieces in batches until they are golden brown, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove the fried beef kidney from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Thread the fried beef kidney pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Top each beef kidney piece with a sprinkle of shredded mozzarella cheese and a date.
Place the skewers under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the kebabs hot and enjoy.
